title: What is NAP in Local SEO? - BrightLocal

facts.fact: NAP is shorthand for Name, Address, and Phone number, the three pieces of local business information commonly found in directory listings, review sites, and other business profiles.
facts.quote: NAP is shorthand for three powerful pieces of local business information commonly found in directory listings, review sites, and other business profiles:

facts.fact: BrightLocal's page 'What is NAP and why is NAP consistency important?' was last updated in October 2025.
If any one of the three NAP elements is missing from a business mention, the mention is known as a partial NAP.
facts.quote: If any one of the three foundational elements is missing from a business mention, it’s known to be a partial NAP.

facts.fact: Any time a business's name, address, and phone number are mentioned online, a NAP citation is created.
facts.quote: Any time your business name, address, and phone number are mentioned online, a NAP citation is created.

facts.fact: According to the page, a business website can build local citations because its content should naturally include the organization's name, address, and phone number on various pages, such as the contact page or site footer.
facts.quote: For example, it could appear on your contact page, in the footer on each page of your site
